sources.title: lailaba/lailaba-ai · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Lailaba AI is a specialized LoRA adapter built on top of Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B. It is designed to improve the base model's usefulness for programming, technology, cybersecurity-oriented learning, research, education, and Lailaba AI development workflows.

sources.title: GitHub - abstryaproject/lailaba-ai: Self-hosted FastAPI AI assistant ...
sources.snippet: Lailaba AI Assistant A self-hosted FastAPI AI assistant with chat, payments, admin roles, and a security Lab training module. Single Python package — easy to install on any Linux server.
